question: Which of the following is an extension of a temporary file?
solution:
The correct answer is __**.tmp**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Temporary files** are files used by the system to store data while running programs or creating permanent files, such as Word documents or Excel spreadsheets.

 
 
• **.tmp is an extension of a temporary file.**__
